learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to count things super fast by putting them in equal groups!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We can put our toys in small groups of the same size. If you have 2 boxes with 3 cars in each, you have 2 equal groups!
Instead of counting one by one, we can add the same number. Two apples plus two apples makes four apples quickly!
One dog has 4 legs. So, 2 dogs have 4 + 4 legs. We just added the number 4 two times to get 8!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Shoe Pair Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Go look at all the shoes in your house! Count how many pairs (groups of 2) you can find. How many shoes is that in total?

quick_recap: ⭐ Putting things in equal groups helps us count very fast.
⭐ Adding the same number again and again is super fun and easy!
